exposure: Serum concentrations of hydrocodone and its metabolites
CYP2D6 genotypes (extensive, intermediate, poor, ultra-rapid metabolizers)
finding: Pain relief was correlated with plasma concentrations of hydromorphone, a metabolite of hydrocodone, and not with hydrocodone itself, suggesting that CYP2D6 genotype, which influences hydromorphone production, affects pain relief from hydrocodone.
